subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Voice Recognition and Voiceprints
description: One-minute skill: Voice Recognition and Voiceprints.

hook.text: Your voice is as unique as your fingerprint. Banks and governments are using it to identify you.

buildup.text: Voiceprint technology analyzes over 100 vocal characteristics: pitch, cadence, accent, and throat shape.

discovery.text: Banks use voice biometrics to verify customers by phone. Speak naturally and the system confirms your identity.

twist.text: AI voice cloning can now replicate anyone's voice from just a few seconds of audio. Voiceprints can be spoofed.

climax.text: Voice authentication is convenient until AI can imitate you perfectly. Then your voice becomes a vulnerability.

punchline.text: Your voice, your ID. Until AI copies it.

quiz.question: What emerging threat challenges voice biometric security?
options: AI voice cloning can replicate voices from just seconds of audio
Background noise makes voice recognition impossible
